lines.speaker: them

lines.label: honest

lines.text: Do you have capacity for a six week project?

lines.text: Who did the last project like this for you?

lines.text: Oh, I have a lot of happy clients, my work speaks for itself, you know how it is.

lines.text: Yes, it's just me, I don't subcontract anything.

lines.speaker: them

lines.label: number_drift
